name: Genaro Moreno
office: City of Pico Rivera, Member of the City Council

items.text: Genaro Moreno is a candidate for Pico Rivera City Council. He works as a police officer and small business owner. He holds an associate degree from East Los Angeles College and a bachelor’s degree from California State University, Los Angeles.
